## COMPONENT A: blackboard_sync.py

Location: /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/blackboard_sync.py

Reads (in order):
  1. collaboration/blackboard.md — master state
  2. collaboration/rate_limit_status.md — budget status
  3. collaboration/routing_log.md — last 3 entries
  4. session_autosave_latest.md — open items + next priorities

Writes:
  1. collaboration/blackboard_summary.txt — 10-line plain text summary
  2. CLAUDE.md — updates sentinel block
  3. OpsCenter/CLAUDE_DESKTOP_INIT.md — updates sentinel block
  4. OpsCenter/GOOSE_INIT.md — updates sentinel block

Behavior:
  - Never crashes — every read/write wrapped in try/except
  - If source file missing — uses "UNKNOWN" gracefully
  - Logs each run to collaboration/routing_log.md (one line)
  - Idempotent — safe to run every 5 minutes forever
  - Zero LLM calls — pure Python file I/O

## COMPONENT F: Sentinel Blocks in Init Files

Three files get auto-updated sections added once, then kept current by blackboard_sync.py.
Sentinel pattern (same for all three):

  # BLACKBOARD_START — auto-updated by blackboard_sync.py — do not edit manually
  [content injected here]
  # BLACKBOARD_END

Files:
  1. /home/john/Thunderbird/CLAUDE.md
     → Claude Code reads this on every session start — blackboard state automatic
  2. /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/CLAUDE_DESKTOP_INIT.md
     → When Commander pastes this (Claude Desktop/Chromebook), state is current
  3. /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/GOOSE_INIT.md
     → Backup to TOM — if TOM fails, paste-in still has current state

Setup: Add sentinel comments once manually, then blackboard_sync.py owns the content.

## COMPONENT G: Systemd Timer

Service file: /home/john/.config/systemd/user/thunderbird-blackboard-sync.service
Timer file:   /home/john/.config/systemd/user/thunderbird-blackboard-sync.timer

Service config:
  Type=oneshot
  ExecStart=/home/john/Thunderbird/.venv/bin/python3 .../blackboard_sync.py
  WorkingDirectory=/home/john/Thunderbird
  EnvironmentFile=/home/john/Thunderbird/.env

Timer config:
  OnBootSec=60s
  OnUnitActiveSec=5min
  AccuracySec=10s

Add to watchdog SERVICES dict:
  "thunderbird-blackboard-sync": "Blackboard Sync"
  (watchdog monitors it like all other services)
